evidence.field: 字形; 形義通解; lines 140–178
evidence.text: The page distinguishes oracle-bone, bronze, and seal-script examples for 外. It reports an analysis of the oracle form as 卜, with crack orientation marking “outside,” and bronze forms adding 月 as a phonetic marker. It also says 月 and 夕 were originally the same graph and reports earlier bronze 外 with 月 and later bronze forms with 夕. This supports reporting the source’s analysis while retaining uncertainty about the earliest graph; the page does not establish a full dated sequence.
